subject: mathematics

sections.scope_note: Arizona standards deferred per Ivan (2026-10-03). This crosswalk covers Florida B.E.S.T. Mathematics ↔ IB PYP Mathematics only.

rows.topic_domain: Number Sense - Place Value to Millions
rows.key_differences: Florida specifies numbers to 1,000,000 with standard, expanded, and word forms, plus rounding to nearest 10, 100, or 1,000. PYP develops place value through phases without specific number limits.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Use inquiry-based exploration of large numbers in real contexts (population, distances), connecting place value patterns to the 'form' of our number system.

rows.key_differences: Florida specifies decimals to hundredths, including plotting, ordering, and adding/subtracting. PYP connects decimals to fractions and real-world measurement.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Explore decimals through money and measurement contexts, connecting decimal notation to fraction understanding and place value patterns.

rows.key_differences: Florida requires fact automaticity through 12×12, multiplying 3-digit by 2-digit with reliability, and standard algorithm for 2×2 with fluency. PYP emphasizes conceptual understanding.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Build fact fluency through pattern exploration while developing multi-digit multiplication strategies, culminating in efficient algorithms with understanding.

rows.key_differences: Florida specifies 4-digit ÷ 1-digit with remainders as fractions. PYP develops division as inverse of multiplication in meaningful contexts.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Explore division through sharing and grouping contexts, connecting remainders to fractions as parts of groups.

rows.key_differences: Florida specifies tenths/hundredths equivalence, decimal notation for fractions, and comparing fractions with different denominators. PYP develops fraction understanding through part-whole relationships.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Use visual models to connect fractions, decimals, and equivalence, building flexible number sense across representations.

rows.key_differences: Florida specifies decomposing fractions, adding/subtracting like denominators, adding tenths and hundredths, and multiplying fractions by whole numbers. PYP develops operations conceptually.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Use visual models and real contexts (recipes, measurements) to develop fraction operations, connecting procedures to meaning.

rows.key_differences: Florida specifies multi-step problems with all operations including fraction contexts. PYP emphasizes mathematical reasoning and real-world application.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Pose authentic multi-step problems from unit inquiries, requiring students to determine operations and interpret results in context.

ib_framework_elements: PYP Mathematics: Pattern and function strand
rows.key_differences: Florida specifies determining equation truth and writing equations with unknowns. PYP develops algebraic thinking through pattern and function exploration.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Use balance models and number puzzles to develop equation understanding, connecting to the concept of mathematical function.

ib_framework_elements: PYP Mathematics: Pattern and function strand
rows.key_differences: Florida specifies factor pairs, prime/composite through 144, and numerical patterns with rules. PYP embeds pattern recognition across mathematical strands.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Investigate factor relationships and number patterns through inquiry, discovering properties that change and properties that stay constant.

rows.key_differences: Florida specifies appropriate tool selection and unit conversions within systems (length, mass, capacity, time). PYP develops measurement as inquiry skill.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Integrate measurement tools and conversions into science and social studies inquiries, applying appropriate units to real investigations.

ib_framework_elements: PYP Transdisciplinary Theme: How we organize ourselves
rows.key_differences: Florida specifies two-step distance/time problems and money problems with decimals. PYP connects measurement to organizing daily life.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Design real-world projects involving scheduling, budgeting, and planning that require distance, time, and money calculations.

ib_framework_elements: PYP Mathematics: Shape and space strand
rows.key_differences: Florida specifies angle classification, protractor measurement, and solving for unknown angles. PYP explores angles as attributes of shapes.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Investigate angles in architecture and art, using protractors to measure and discover angle relationships.

rows.key_differences: Florida specifies perimeter/area with unknown sides and exploring same perimeter/different area relationships. PYP connects measurement to function.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Design garden beds, rooms, or game boards exploring how perimeter and area relate and differ, discovering measurement functions.

rows.key_differences: Florida specifies stem-and-leaf plots, line plots with fractions, and mode/median/range. PYP develops data handling as inquiry skill.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Embed data collection in unit inquiries, using appropriate representations and measures of center to answer research questions.
